category: currency exchange-rate API (fiat and crypto rates, conversion, VAT rates, IBAN validation, holiday calendars, central bank rates)

free_tier.stated: Free tier USD 0 per month: 200 requests per day (6,000 per month) and 30 requests per minute, 170+ fiat currencies and 500+ cryptocurrencies, real-time exchange rates, currency conversion, EU VAT rates, IBAN validation, public holiday and business-day calendars, central bank policy rates and CPI inflation; no historical data access.
free_tier.notes: Limits reset at 00:00 UTC; at the limit the API answers HTTP 429 with a reset timestamp and there are no overage charges. Historical rates, time series, precious metals and commodities are on Pro at USD 9 a month with 25,000 requests per day and 1,000 historical requests per day. A keyless widget endpoint on the same host is recorded separately.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-response cap is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: not applicable: a query API with no stored objects; the Free tier has no historical data access

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 200 requests a day bound what a free key can pull

interface_detail: GET https://api.unirateapi.com/api/{endpoint} (rates, convert, currencies, historical, vat, iban, calendar, macro) with the key in the api_key query parameter; JSON, XML or JSONP, with an OpenAPI document at https://api.unirateapi.com/apispec_1.json.
tooling: any HTTP client; code samples for Python, Node.js, Go, PHP and cURL
chaining: 200 requests a day of fiat and crypto rates with VAT, IBAN, holiday and central bank data but no history, so a free stack caches one rates call per refresh; the keyless widget endpoint of the same vendor serves rates at 60 requests a minute per IP, and history needs Pro or another source.

limits.value: 200 requests per day (6,000 per month) on the Free tier, reset at 00:00 UTC
30 requests per minute on the Free tier

limits_note: Plan gating: Free has no historical data access; historical rates, time series, precious metals, commodities, VAT number validation and market calendars are Pro. Bulk path: one rates call for a base returns a map of rates.
binding_note: 200 requests a day is met long before 30 per minute could be.

identity_cost.detail: The register page offers Sign up with Google or an email, a password and a password confirmation with a how-did-you-hear-about-us field; the pricing page says the Free tier needs no credit card.

reliability_note: At the limit the API answers HTTP 429 with a reset timestamp; a call with no key answered HTTP 401 Missing API key.
confidence_note: The tier, limits and features are read from the first-party pricing, home and forex pages, and a keyless call answered HTTP 401. A free key was not exercised, so the answer at the limit is unverified: behind a sign-up.
